d:
Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez launches a sharp attack on Donald Trump at a Virginia rally for Congressman Eugene Vindman, accusing the administration of corruption, intimidation and putting billionaire interests ahead of working Americans. She also slams Trump over the Iran war, rising costs and healthcare cuts, urging voters to choose a government that serves the working class.
